title: Premium Deck Series: Slivers: card flavor text

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A tyrant of Rath whose influence over the slivers grew; long dead, the slivers became his mindless instruments of destruction.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Crew member of the Weatherlight who searches for the source of a mysterious pulse before slivers boil forth.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: The Weatherlight's navigator.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior who banters with Hanna about the slivers.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship around which slivers form a hedge of spines.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who tells the sliver queen he needs the pieces of the Legacy to be whole.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: The queen of the slivers, to whom Karn speaks of kinship.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who says the land is weary and mana must be found elsewhere.

entities.name: Rukarumel
entities.description: Author of a field journal on slivers.

entities.name: Llanach
entities.description: A Skyshroud ranger who describes a colossal sliver rumbling over a ridge.

entities.name: Adom Capashen
entities.description: A Benalish hero who describes a rift opened by a fury sliver.

entities.name: Thed
entities.description: A victim wounded in the chest by a sliver's claw.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A faerie queen whose song calls faeries home so she can feast on their stolen dreams.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: A figure who became both executioner and savior, helping others to rebirth.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A Hydra-god of Alara whose awakening made the ziggurat reemerge.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose creatures a vanished ziggurat honored.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Hive-minded creatures that nest across Otaria and were experimented on.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land where more slivers nested than ever existed on Rath.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane where slivers once lived.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: A research group whose directors wanted instant results from sliver experiments.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: An organization whose agents are rumored around the sliver labs.

events.summary: A clever counterfeit is accepted by the sliver hive, strengthening Volrath's influence upon the slivers.
events.quote: When the clever counterfeit was accepted by the hive, Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

events.summary: Gerrard looks for the source of a mysterious pulse and slivers boil forth from the crevasses.
events.quote: at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

events.summary: Freyalise says the land is weary and another source of mana must be found.
events.quote: We must find another source of mana

events.summary: The Riptide Project's directors want instant results from sliver experiments and get them.
Karn tells the sliver queen they are kinfolk, as he needs the pieces of the Legacy to be whole.
Hanna and Mirri banter about learning how slivers protect each other.
events.quote: We must learn how they protect each other.

events.summary: Spines of slivers leap between them, forming a hedge around the Weatherlight.
events.quote: forming a deadly hedge around the

events.summary: Slivers, long after Volrath's death, become what he wanted: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.
Within weeks more slivers nest in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.
events.quote: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

events.summary: Llanach describes a colossal sliver rumbling over a ridge as the slivers they fought surged and howled.
events.quote: we knew it was time to flee.

events.summary: Adom Capashen recounts a rift opening and Thed wounded by a sliver's claw.
events.quote: A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled.

events.summary: Phage becomes executioner and savior, helping others to the rebirth she found.
events.quote: Phage became both executioner and savior

events.summary: When Progenitus awakens, the vanished ziggurat honoring Alara's creatures reemerges.
events.quote: When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

relations.note: Karn claims kinship with the sliver queen.
